Name: FS - Apollo Justice Ace Attorney Hairstyles
Author: hychlorions
Description:
[size=4][b]for the low low price of downloading this mod, now you too can play as apollo justice ace attorney characters in stardew valley (Farmer Portrait not included)

[/b][/size][size=3]Currently[/size][size=4] contains hairstyles for Apollo Justice and Klavier Gavin, plus earrings for Klavier. Klavier Gavin's hair lets you change the undertones of his hair, and includes a version with roots (also customizable), useful for if you headcanon that he dyes his hair blond :)) 
[/size]
This is a content pack for PeacefulEnd's Fashion Sense mod. As such, you will need that installed in order for this content pack to work. 

Simply extract the contents of the zip file into your mods folder. Enjoy!
